prompt: How many more points did Michael Jordan average in his sophomore season (regular season) in the NBA than the first black NBA player averaged during his career (regular season)? Show me a math equation to justify your answer.
answer:
Michael Jordan averaged **22.7 points per game** in his sophomore NBA season (1985–86). Earl Lloyd—the first Black player to appear in an NBA game—averaged **8.4 points per game** during his career.

\[
22.7 - 8.4 = \boxed{14.3}
\]

**Jordan averaged 14.3 more points per game.**
